visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A pair of hands with dark red nail polish is seen holding several red envelopes on a white marble surface. The top envelopes feature LINE Friends characters, specifically Brown the bear and Cony the rabbit, under 'HAPPY NEW YEAR' text. (2) The scene cuts to three Google-branded red envelopes. The designs use intricate gold dot patterns to illustrate a snake and the number '2025', signifying the Year of the Snake. (3) The hands open a box with a blue and orange gradient and the 'Meta' logo. Inside is a vibrant purple card with a lantern-shaped cutout featuring yellow emoji icons. (4) The camera shifts to a white fluffy surface covered in numerous red Chanel-branded envelopes, each tied with a red ribbon. (5) A hand opens a specific Chanel red envelope which features a gold wax-seal style logo and an embossed wheat ear pattern on the surface. (6) The final shot shows a hand holding the Chanel envelope in front of a colorful bouquet of pink roses and white hydrangeas.
